name: Rest-based resource recovery
default: Ordinary limited ability uses recover on the explicitly granted Short Rest, Long Rest or other rest event. A historical once-per-day ability ordinarily becomes one use regained at the end of a Long Rest rather than a midnight/calendar-day reset.
exceptions: Real day boundaries, elapsed time, multi-day effects, item mechanics and other expressly selected cooldowns may remain calendar/elapsed-time based.
restrictions: Do not grant Short Rest recovery to an ability that only specifies Long Rest recovery.
Completing a qualifying Long Rest is not the same as midnight or mere passage of 24 hours.
Do not replace already selected longer recovery schedules, such as an explicit seven-day cooldown.
This policy does not grant additional rests or restore independent resource pools.
